functional_contracts.responsibility: Validate trusted server data and persist the order atomically before payment is allowed.
functional_contracts.precondition: The request is new and no payment exists.
guarantees: Client-supplied prices never become the authoritative amount.
A persistence failure cannot leave an order payable with a partial inventory update.

functional_contracts.responsibility: Choose exactly one legal decision while the order is payable: start payment, cancel, or reject a duplicate/invalid request.
functional_contracts.precondition: Order is PAYMENT_PENDING, amount was verified and inventory is reserved.
guarantees: Payment and cancellation decisions are serialized.
A rejected or duplicate request cannot create another logical payment.

functional_contracts.responsibility: Resolve the gateway outcome with bounded retry and one idempotency key without interpreting timeout as decline.
functional_contracts.precondition: The order is payable and no successful payment has been committed.
guarantees: Only an authenticated definitive decline may end the payment flow as FAILED.
An UNKNOWN outcome keeps inventory reserved and is reconciled with the same idempotency key.
A successful charge is committed at most once.

functional_contracts.responsibility: Confirm a paid order or start compensation when confirmation cannot succeed.
guarantees: A failed or repeated confirmation never charges the customer again.
A paid order that cannot be confirmed either stays PAID for manual retry or enters compensation instead of FAILED.

functional_contracts.responsibility: Complete delivery or compensate a paid order that can no longer be fulfilled.
functional_contracts.precondition: Order is CONFIRMED and successful payment evidence is retained.
guarantees: Post-payment fulfillment failure always starts refund compensation.

functional_contracts.responsibility: Finish compensation idempotently and release inventory only with durable refund evidence.
functional_contracts.precondition: A successful charge exists and the order is REFUND_PENDING.
guarantees: Refund retry uses the same refund idempotency key.
A timeout cannot be treated as proof that no refund occurred.

functional_contracts.responsibility: Reject late mutation and return the stored result without reviving a terminal aggregate.
guarantees: No terminal state is revived by a late request or callback.
Repeated terminal operations are idempotent and auditable.

properties.description: No reachable state is explicitly unsafe.
Every paid state has successful payment evidence.
A cancelled order cannot contain a successful charge.
FAILED is used only when no successful charge exists.
Payment and cancellation never own the critical resource simultaneously.
Every declared state is reachable from CREATED.
Every state documents detection, solution and next state for each incident.
Ignoring explicitly marked stutter retries, every reachable state inevitably reaches a terminal state.
Every state/event transition belongs to exactly one function and matches its declared outcome.
A terminal state can only reject/no-op and remain in the same terminal state.
A failure after successful payment can only preserve paid evidence or enter the refund path, never FAILED/CANCELLED.
An unknown payment outcome remains non-terminal with inventory reserved until an authoritative outcome is known.
Within one state, one event has exactly one declared next state.

state_response_matrix.guarantees: Client-supplied prices never become the authoritative amount. | A persistence failure cannot leave an order payable with a partial inventory update.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: The request is new and no payment exists.

state_response_matrix.guarantees: Client-supplied prices never become the authoritative amount. | A persistence failure cannot leave an order payable with a partial inventory update.

state_response_matrix.guarantees: Client-supplied prices never become the authoritative amount. | A persistence failure cannot leave an order payable with a partial inventory update.

state_response_matrix.guarantees: Payment and cancellation decisions are serialized. | A rejected or duplicate request cannot create another logical payment.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Payment remains PROCESSING while the gateway has a final result
state_response_matrix.solution: Reconcile the existing charge; do not increase the charge attempt counter
state_response_matrix.guarantees: Only an authenticated definitive decline may end the payment flow as FAILED. | An UNKNOWN outcome keeps inventory reserved and is reconciled with the same idempotency key. | A successful charge is committed at most once.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Successful payment evidence exists.
state_response_matrix.solution: Confirm fulfillment and preserve the successful payment evidence.
state_response_matrix.guarantees: A failed or repeated confirmation never charges the customer again. | A paid order that cannot be confirmed either stays PAID for manual retry or enters compensation instead of FAILED.

state_response_matrix.problem: Duplicate success callback or client retry
state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: The order already has a SUCCESS payment for the idempotency key
state_response_matrix.solution: Return the original payment; do not insert or charge again
state_response_matrix.guarantees: A failed or repeated confirmation never charges the customer again. | A paid order that cannot be confirmed either stays PAID for manual retry or enters compensation instead of FAILED.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Fulfillment confirmation fails before the order is confirmed
state_response_matrix.solution: Keep PAID and let an operator retry confirmation or start compensation; no automatic retry counter exists
state_response_matrix.guarantees: A failed or repeated confirmation never charges the customer again. | A paid order that cannot be confirmed either stays PAID for manual retry or enters compensation instead of FAILED.

state_response_matrix.problem: Order cannot be fulfilled after payment
state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Permanent inventory or fulfillment failure
state_response_matrix.solution: Start compensation; never silently change PAID to FAILED
state_response_matrix.guarantees: A failed or repeated confirmation never charges the customer again. | A paid order that cannot be confirmed either stays PAID for manual retry or enters compensation instead of FAILED.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Order is CONFIRMED and successful payment evidence is retained.
state_response_matrix.solution: Close the successful order.
state_response_matrix.guarantees: Completion preserves successful payment evidence. | Post-payment fulfillment failure always starts refund compensation.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: The order cannot be delivered
state_response_matrix.solution: Start a refund and release inventory when compensation completes
state_response_matrix.guarantees: Completion preserves successful payment evidence. | Post-payment fulfillment failure always starts refund compensation.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: A successful charge exists and the order is REFUND_PENDING.
state_response_matrix.solution: Persist refund evidence and release inventory.
state_response_matrix.guarantees: Refund retry uses the same refund idempotency key. | A timeout cannot be treated as proof that no refund occurred.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: No authenticated final refund result
state_response_matrix.solution: Retry or query with the same refund idempotency key and alert operations
state_response_matrix.guarantees: Refund retry uses the same refund idempotency key. | A timeout cannot be treated as proof that no refund occurred.

state_response_matrix.problem: Late duplicate callback or state-change request
state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Order is already terminal
state_response_matrix.solution: Return the stored result, reject state mutation and audit the event
state_response_matrix.guarantees: No terminal state is revived by a late request or callback. | Repeated terminal operations are idempotent and auditable.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Order is terminal CANCELLED
state_response_matrix.solution: Reject the charge/state mutation and raise an alert if the gateway reports money captured
state_response_matrix.guarantees: No terminal state is revived by a late request or callback. | Repeated terminal operations are idempotent and auditable.

state_response_matrix.problem: Late retry attempts to revive a rejected request
state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: The original create transaction was rejected or rolled back
state_response_matrix.solution: Reject mutation; require a corrected new request with a new operation identity
state_response_matrix.guarantees: No terminal state is revived by a late request or callback. | Repeated terminal operations are idempotent and auditable.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Order is terminal FAILED
state_response_matrix.solution: Reject mutation; require a new order rather than reviving this one
state_response_matrix.guarantees: No terminal state is revived by a late request or callback. | Repeated terminal operations are idempotent and auditable.

state_response_matrix.guard_or_detection: Refund transaction is already final

state_response_matrix.guarantees: No terminal state is revived by a late request or callback. | Repeated terminal operations are idempotent and auditable.

negative_scenarios.description: A cancelled order is revived and paid.
A mismatched amount is accepted as paid.
Two successful payments are persisted for one order.
Payment and cancellation enter their critical sections together.
A paid order loses successful-payment evidence by moving directly to FAILED instead of compensation.

P13.reason: successful payment evidence was lost without compensation

negative_scenarios.description: An unknown gateway outcome is incorrectly made terminal and inventory is released.

P14.reason: UNKNOWN outcome is terminal, released, or incorrectly marked successful
